correctness.rationale: The finite exact graph isomorphism follows from exhaustive incidence-permutation generation of all 42 perfect matchings and all legal 3-assignment flips. Both sign classes have 21 states and individually exhibit the exact three-hub/three-disjoint-C6 alternating attachment characterization of T. The separate eighteen-vertex LCF graph code builds and enumerates all 18 simple hexagons and all matching symmetric differences, confirming the 72 switches and diameter 4; both checkers run to completion from the package, using only stdlib. The result is not a general-n inference.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the complete unrestricted abstract six-cycle perfect-matching flip graph of the Pappus graph, as two explicit isomorphic connected 21-state graphs. Existing Pappus 2-factor results, sign parity, abstract matching complex topology, and selected-facial resonance-graph theorems are compared at the level of implication. value.rationale: For a canonical small cubic girth-six bipartite Levi graph, determine whether local perfect-matching reconfiguration is connected and which obstructions explain failure. The known sign invariant provides only separation, whereas the two exact 21-vertex T components prove within-parity reachability and reveal three hubs, three peripheral six-cycles, and exact diameter four. This is a natural complete structural classification of an otherwise nonobvious finite reconfiguration state space, useful for comparing unrestricted-cycle and face-restricted resonance dynamics; neither mere matching count nor routine normalization.
